sentence: This project studies how psychological and physiological processes interact as reflux disease symptoms unfold in daily life.
This project provides stem cell and organoid development and cell analysis services, including flow cytometry, to support vision research.
This project provides genome-wide sequencing methods to help researchers understand how metabolic disease develops, and how it can be diagnosed and treated.
This project studies how lymphatic transport in the skin works and how it contributes to immune surveillance.
This project builds a medical device that combines ultrasound imaging with optics and machine learning to monitor cervical changes during pregnancy.
This project tests whether AI-assisted teleglaucoma care improves early detection and monitoring of glaucoma in a large municipal health system.
This project uses imaging to study inflammation and coronary artery disease in people with HIV.
This project provides spatial and single-cell genomics methods to profile immune cells and malignant cells in glioblastoma.
This project tries to find which T cells and parasite epitopes are linked to protection against malaria in adults.
This project provides genomic sequencing services and develops methods for working with cancer tissue samples from patients.
This project tests whether a meditation app helps youth in the legal system with substance use, sexual health and emotion regulation.
This project builds a model that combines imaging, clinical notes and structured data to predict long-term outcomes for stroke patients.
This project studies how one target affects tumor antigen presentation and anti-tumor immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.
This project builds a large dataset to support health research and personalized prevention and treatment.
This project builds a computer model to study how blood-contacting medical devices damage von Willebrand factor and platelet receptors.
This project builds imaging tools that find subtle brain abnormalities in children with drug-resistant epilepsy before surgery.
This project tries to find out how neutrophils in the lung release their nuclei to fight pathogens in infected tissues.
This project builds a microscope that records voltage across the whole nervous system of Zebra fish larvae at high speed.
This project tries to find what determines response to checkpoint blockade in malignant pleural mesothelioma using single cell analysis.
This project tries to find out how hypoxia and metabolism control immune cells in tumors.
